title: AtlasSourceRecord
description: A citable source with authority tier and retrieval metadata. Primary official sources are always preferred over secondary coverage. Specification version 0.1.0.

source_type.description: Tier D community sources (issues, discussions, forums) help discover problems but never become facts on their own.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL. Relative strings and bare text are rejected by the pattern constraint.

accessed_at.description: ISO 8601 access timestamp with timezone. Never fabricated.

revision.description: Immutable revision (commit/hash/tag) when reproducibility matters. Content on main/master branches drifts over time.

authority_level.description: Tier A: official repos/docs/licenses/specs/papers. Tier B: reputable independent benchmarks/measurements. Tier C: quantizer repos and specialist reports. Tier D: community channels.

archived_reference.description: Archive copy (e.g. web archive) when long-term citability matters.
